title: Recording: Have You Seen My Baby, Devil Woman by Ringo Starr | 1973
content:
Producers Workshop, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

Ringo Starr worked on two songs for his third studio album, Ringo, on 11 July 1973.

This was an overdub session. The backing track for ‘Have You Seen My Baby’ had been recorded on 5 March, with initial overdubs taped on 15 May.

‘Devil Woman’ had been started on 8 March, with initial overdubs recorded on 12 May. It was completed on this day.

Page last updated: 15 September 2026
